product_overview: Maju Bersama POS & Accounting is a multi-branch retail system for managing staff sign-in, product catalogs, branch listings, and cashier operations. It supports backoffice access for staff to view and maintain core store data after logging in.
core_goals: Allow staff to sign in before accessing backoffice or cashier tools
Let authorized staff view and manage the product catalog
Let staff open the cashier screen to process in-store sales
Let staff view branch information across the company

features.name: Login
features.description: Staff sign in with email and password to access the ERP.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the backoffice area
Navigate to /login -> Enter an email and password with invalid or missing values -> Submit the sign-in form -> See validation feedback on the login page

features.name: Product catalog
features.description: Authorized staff view the branch-scoped product catalog and can open the new product form.
user_flows: Navigate to /backoffice/products -> See the product table for the current branch
Navigate to /backoffice/products/create -> See the new product form

features.name: Cashier
features.description: Staff open the cashier screen to sell products after logging in.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos -> See the cashier screen

features.name: Branch management
features.description: Authorized staff view the list of branches in the backoffice.
user_flows: Navigate to /backoffice/branches -> See the branch table

features.name: Login
features.description: Staff sign in to the ERP before using the cashier or backoffice.

endpoints.description: Sign in with email and password

features.name: Product catalog

features.name: Branch management

known_limitations.issue: Product catalog can be empty after the go-live cleanup
known_limitations.impact: Product list and cashier may show no products until staff enter them

known_limitations.issue: Local seeder password is only for the test server
known_limitations.impact: Do not use production passwords in the test plan
